weekLabel: Week of Jun 30 - Jul 6 · refreshed Wed Jul 1. Tap a source to confirm before you go.

events.name: Ogunquit 4th of July Fireworks
events.meta: Free · Ogunquit Beach, ME. You are already up there Jul 2-4, so this is your holiday: DJ Don spinning requests from 7pm at the Beach Street turnaround, fireworks over the water at 9:15pm. Watch from Main Beach, the Marginal Way, or Footbridge Beach. The Main Beach lot closes early for pyro setup, so walk from town or grab a spot early. Rain date Jul 5. source

events.name: Boston Harborfest
events.meta: Free · Downtown Boston / waterfront. One of the country's biggest July 4th festivals, and 2026 marks the 250th anniversary of the Revolution: reenactors, USS Constitution turnaround sail, Freedom Trail tours, free live music at Christopher Columbus Park. Harborfest fireworks Thu Jul 2 at 9:15pm from Long Wharf. source

events.name: Boston Pops July 4 Fireworks Spectacular
events.meta: Free · Hatch Shell, Charles River Esplanade. The marquee holiday one, 52nd year and the official Mass 250 event: Keith Lockhart and the Pops with Lainey Wilson, Chance the Rapper, Trombone Shorty and Megan Hilty, hosted by Jane Lynch, plus a drone show and fireworks at 9:15pm. Huge crowds, arrive midday. (You'll likely be in Maine, but it's here if plans shift.) source

events.when: Sat Jul 4, pet parade 6pm, concert 7:30pm, fireworks 10:15pm
events.name: Salisbury Beach July 4 Concert + Fireworks
events.meta: Free · Salisbury oceanfront. Scott Brown & The Diplomats on the Oceanfront Stage at 7:30pm, fireworks over the water at 10:15pm, plus a pet parade 6-7pm on the Broadway Loop. Young Performers Club plays Sun Jul 5. Easy beach evening for all five. source

events.name: Gloucester + Rockport July 3 Parades & Fireworks
events.meta: Free · Cape Ann. Gloucester's Fishtown Horribles Parade at 6pm, then fireworks over the harbor at 9:30pm from Stage Fort Park. Nearby Rockport runs its Firemen's Parade at 6pm, Legion Band concert at 8pm, and a towering Back Beach bonfire at dusk (~9pm). Ocean + hometown-parade energy. source

events.name: Marblehead Harbor Illumination & Fireworks
events.meta: Free · Marblehead. A beloved North Shore tradition: the harbor lit with flares while fireworks go up over one of the prettiest harbors in range. Confirm exact start time on the town site (verify). Park up top and walk down. source

events.name: Prescott Park Arts Festival: The Dip
events.meta: $20 suggested donation · Portsmouth NH waterfront. Seattle soul-funk band The Dip on the Wilcox Main Stage tonight. Bring chairs and a picnic, pair with a Portsmouth dinner. More to come this month: Kashus Culpepper Jul 15, Patty Griffin Jul 20. source

events.name: SoWa Open Market
events.meta: Free entry · South End, Boston. 100+ vendors, food trucks, vintage and makers in a walkable block. Stacey's city-day pick, easy to graze and bail. source

events.name: World Cup Quarter-Final at Gillette
events.meta: Ticketed (steep) · Gillette Stadium, Foxborough. Boston's biggest World Cup match, a quarter-final on Thu Jul 9 (teams set by the bracket). Tickets and parking are heavy, so the family play is a watch party or a bar with the game on for Dave & Alex. Last Gillette match of the tournament. source

events.name: Yarmouth Clam Festival - Maine
events.meta: Free entry · Yarmouth ME. Classic Maine seafood weekend: fried clams, the big parade, live music, midway. Dave bait, worth the drive. source

events.when: Trampled by Turtles Jul 26; The Head and the Heart Aug 2
events.name: Thompson's Point Concerts - Portland ME
events.meta: Ticketed · Portland ME waterfront. Summer shows worth booking ahead: Trampled by Turtles Jul 26, The Head and the Heart Aug 2, Guster Aug 8-9, Lake Street Dive Aug 15-16. Good one for KK if any land right. source

events.name: Maine Lobster Festival - Rockland
events.meta: Ticketed grounds · Rockland ME. 79th year: lobster every way, the big parade, live music on the bay. A full-day-plus trip, but peak Maine summer. source
